verdict.rationale: Honeycomb's API and MCP docs mention API keys and programmatic key management (honeycomb-docs-11, honeycomb-docs-27) and connecting an AI agent to Honeycomb via MCP (honeycomb-docs-9, honeycomb-docs-34), but there is no evidence of scoped, least-privilege, or role-restricted API key issuance specifically for agent use — no mention of permission tiers, scopes, or credential minimization features tied to agent access.
